Fatema Bibi vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 13
September, 2023
Author: Suvra Ghosh

Bench: Suvra Ghosh
September 13, 2023
 Ardr (21)
 Wpa 14935 of 2023
 Fatema Bibi
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & ors.
 Adv. Tushar Kanti Mukherjee,
 ...for the petitioner.

Adv. Chandi Charan De,
 Adv. Anirban Sarkar,
 Adv. S.K. Halder,
 ...for the State.
Affidavit of service filed by the petitioner is taken on  record.

The petitioner claims to be the recorded owner of the  plot in question and complains that the Public Works  Department, West Bengal has encroached upon seven  decimals of land for construction of Bhaduria Bazar Road.
No acquisition proceeding was initiated, far less any  compensation paid for the same.
The petitioner submitted  a representation before the concerned authority in this  regard on 14th February, 2023 which is yet to be  considered.
The petitioner prays for a direction upon the  authority to consider the representation at the earliest.

It is submitted on behalf of the respondents that the Fatema Bibi vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 13 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9599190/
1 6th respondent be directed to consider the representation in accordance with law in order to ascertain whether the plot of the petitioner or any portion thereof has been encroached upon by the department.

sentences.text: In view of the above, the writ petition is disposed of directing the 6th respondent to consider and dispose of the representation submitted by the petitioner dated 14 th February, 2023 within two months from the date of communication of this order upon affording reasonable opportunity of hearing to all the interested persons including the petitioner, in accordance with law.
The 6th respondent is directed to ascertain whether any encroachment was made by the Public Works Department upon the petitioner's land or any portion thereof.
